_readme: firestore.rules is still hand-pasted into the console by hand (see docs/DEPLOY_CHECKLIST.md), never deployed from here. `firebase emulators:start` never touches the real project no matter what project id this file names. Cloud Functions ARE deployed from here now (`firebase deploy --only functions`, docs/DEPLOY_CHECKLIST.md step 4) - the predeploy hook below copies economy.json into functions/ first, since `firebase deploy` only uploads functions.source's own directory and functions/lib/economyData.js reads economy.json by a relative path that only resolves locally/in the emulator otherwise (see that file's own note).
